spec: A2UI v0.9 message model (createSurface, updateComponents, updateDataModel); https://a2ui.org
description: The trusted component catalog for Cedwyn webapps. A surface may use only these components; tools/a2ui_render.py renders them at build time with each app's own CSS classes. Data strings are escaped; content links remain root-relative or relative. Page head scripts may use the canonical https://cedwyn.bucklerfamily.estate/_cedwyn/ asset path only.
binding: A prop is a literal, {"path": "/absolute/pointer"} into the surface data model, {"path": "relative"} into the current template item, or {"fmt": "…{name}…", "args": {name: binding}}. children: [ids] or {"path": list, "componentId": template}.

components.Page: document shell: title, description, css[], headScripts[{src,defer,attrs}], js[], htmlAttrs, cedwynPath, bodyClass, mainClass, children
components.Heading: h1–h4 (level, text, className)
components.Text: paragraph (text, label, className); empty text renders nothing
components.Section: section (heading, list, listClass, children); empty renders nothing
components.Card: card: kicker, title, meta[], bodyLabel, body, badge, badgeClass, foot, attrs{}, children
components.DetailSections: [{heading, text|items|runs, form: section|term}] → h2 sections and dl terms
components.Meter: accessible progress meter (value, max, label, className)
